Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like your focus on committed business makes continuity especially important to this renewal. We value the relationship and want a straightforward agreement that supports dependable planning for you. How would a longer agreement affect your pricing, and could you share the hourly-rate and material cost breakdown you offered as an XLSX so we can work through the underlying elements together?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our recent orders for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 were at 4.29, 4.39 per 1 (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10). Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.84 per unit, 60 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. While we note your historical purchase data, this price reflects the necessary conditions to maintain our high service standards. We are pleased to support your planning with a 36-month agreement and 60-day payment terms at a revised price of €4.91 per unit. To be clear, our offer is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

You have acknowledged the historical data while holding to your service-based calculation—it sounds like sustaining service is what matters most. We want a straightforward, lasting agreement that supports that continuity. How can we close this renewal on a sustainable basis for both sides?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.85 per unit, 60 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

As to the index change data you cited, that does not change our position. We have verified the LCI-C index data you cited; however, it does not alter our overall cost calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. That remains.

To ensure the sustainable service and continuity you require, our price must remain at €4.91 per unit. We therefore hold our offer at €4.91 per unit for a 36-month contract with 60-day payment terms. Our current Angebot is a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Our offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing inquiry. Regarding your request for a detailed cost breakdown, please note that we do not share internal cost structures or margins beyond the primary drivers already provided. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Please consider this as our Angebot: a price of €4.91 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

We value our partnership and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
